cause: A read-only status probe used a command name that is not part of the formal CLI surface; the first append retry also supplied an event file outside the repository-relative input boundary.

cause: Controlled RED probes showed a caller-created request identity reached the report view seam, object.__new__ projection handling was not typed, and invalid outer wire fields fell back to valid nested fields.
impact: Before the implementation change, Report facts could be admitted without the exact owner-bound request identity and malformed outer index assertions could be hidden by nested values.
lesson: Require the exact owner-bound request identity and reject any present invalid or conflicting outer/nested evidence field before canonical projection.

cause: The minimal owner admission change now requires the exact live C0 owner and owner-bound request identity before typed Report facts are returned.
impact: The caller-created identity and object.__new__ projection probes fail closed while the owner-admitted projection path remains available.
lesson: Use identity-bound server capability admission at the typed Report view seam and preserve a controlled host positive path.

cause: Strict index parsing now rejects present invalid outer binding, envelope, and envelope-reference values instead of selecting valid nested fallbacks.
impact: The three malformed outer/nested probes are blocked with empty facts while canonical owner-admitted evidence remains on the typed path.
lesson: Treat presence, validity, and equality as separate evidence admission checks; truthiness is not a provenance rule.

cause: The frontend parser accepted forged facts after the caller recomputed a self-consistent projection digest because it had no independent server receipt anchor.

evidence.ref: frontend/src/report/ReportEvidenceBoundary.v189.test.tsx::rejects a caller-rehashed forged facts pair without a server receipt

impact: A forged pair could enter typed Report facts and selection despite complete-looking provenance.
lesson: Client parsing must compare the server-supplied receipt to the complete candidate identity and provenance; digest recomputation alone is not authorization.

cause: The frontend parser now requires a server-supplied Report receipt for available projections and compares its digest, complete identity, and canonical provenance without recomputing a candidate digest for authorization.
impact: The forged facts pair is rejected both without a receipt and against the original server receipt; the typed workspace and raw classification display-only path remain green.
lesson: Keep the server receipt separate from the candidate projection and validate the full typed provenance at the consumer boundary.

impact: Implementation and all other focused tests passed; the stale test assertion prevented a clean suite result.
